name: Three-Word Anthem Build
why_it_works: A slogan becomes an anthem when people can see where it comes from. Showing three words grow into a full chant, line by line, invites fans into the making of it, and anything people help build they defend and repeat.

hook.pattern: Lead with the three-word slogan alone on a slide, then promise to show how it becomes a stadium anthem.
examples: Three words. One anthem. Swipe to hear it grow.
Every anthem starts as three words on a napkin.

variables.name: slogan
variables.description: Three-word slogan, capitalized, with three strong stresses (one per word)

variables.name: line_two
variables.description: Second chant line, capitalized, 3-5 words with three strong stresses, rhyming with the slogan's last word

variables.name: line_three
variables.description: Third chant line naming who 'we' are, capitalized, 3-5 words with three strong stresses, same rhyme

variables.name: moment
variables.description: When fans will chant it, lowercase, 6 words or fewer

slides.headline: {{slogan}}
slides.body: Three words. Swipe to watch them become an anthem.
slides.visual_prompt: Bold 4:5 title slide, {{slogan}} in huge condensed type, {{brand}} colors, gritty texture

slides.headline: Step 1: stamp the beat
slides.body: Stomp once on each word: {{slogan}}. Three stomps, then rest on beat four.
slides.visual_prompt: Low-angle photo of boots stomping on concrete bleachers, dust in the light, 4:5

slides.headline: Step 2: add the answer
slides.body: {{line_two}}. Same rhythm, same open vowel, easy to shout.
slides.visual_prompt: Wide photo of a crowd silhouette with arms up against stadium lights, 4:5

slides.headline: Step 3: say who we are
slides.body: {{line_three}}. This line is for the people in the seats.
slides.visual_prompt: Photo collage of {{brand}} fans of all ages in team colors, warm light

slides.headline: Step 4: back to the top
slides.body: End where you started: {{slogan}}. Repetition is the anthem.
slides.visual_prompt: Close-up of a scarf or jersey with {{slogan}} stitched on it, dramatic side light

slides.headline: The full anthem
slides.visual_prompt: Lyric-sheet style slide, four lines stacked in big type, {{brand}} crest at the bottom

slides.headline: Chant it with us
slides.body: See you at the {{moment}}. Save this and learn it before then.
slides.visual_prompt: End card with {{brand}} logo, date in large type, stadium photo behind

cta: Save this, learn the words, and chant it with us at the {{moment}}.

craft.technique: Bookended four-line chant (ABCA) built from a three-beat slogan
craft.notes: The slogan needs three strong stresses so each word gets a stomp: RISE to-GE-ther NOW puts the stresses on beats 1, 2 and 3, with beat 4 as a rest. Line two end-rhymes on the same open vowel (now / town), line three names the community and keeps the rhyme (crowd), and line four repeats the slogan: title placement at top and bottom. Suggested tempo/feel: 80-90 BPM stomp-stomp-stomp-rest, chanted not sung, low voices in unison.

do_not: Borrow a real club's chant or a real stadium song's rhythm and words
Pick a slogan with weak syllables on the beat (it won't chant)
Make it about beating a named rival; make it about who you are
